```{r}
data <- read_csv("clean_data.csv")
final_data2 <- read.table("final_data2.dat")


missing_summary <- data.frame(
  variable = colnames(data),
  n_missing = colSums(is.na(data)),
  pct_missing = round(colSums(is.na(data)) / nrow(data) * 100, 2)
)
print(missing_summary)

```

```{r}

clean_data2 <- data %>% 
  select(
    CPUBID_XRND,
    MPUBID_XRND,
    CRACE_XRND,
    CSEX_XRND,
    CYRB_XRND,
    PRE0010_XRND,      
    PRE0012_XRND,     
    PST0002_XRND,      
    PST0009_XRND,      
    PST0010_XRND,      
    PST0011_XRND,      
    SAMPLE_RACE_78SCRN,
    `AFQT-3_1981`
  )

colSums(is.na(clean_data2))
analysis_data <- clean_data2 %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(PRE0012_XRND),   # exposure
    !is.na(PST0009_XRND)    # outcome
  )

cat("Original rows:", nrow(clean_data2), "\n")
cat("After removing NA in exposure/outcome:", nrow(analysis_data), "\n")



```

```{r}
colSums(is.na(analysis_data))

sum(complete.cases(analysis_data))


```

```{r}

write.csv(final_data, "final_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
final_data2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(PST0009_XRND) & !is.na(PRE0012_XRND)) %>%
  group_by(MPUBID_XRND) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  summarise(
    n_observations = n(),
    n_mothers = n_distinct(MPUBID_XRND)
  )
final_data2 <- final_data2 %>%
  mutate(AFQT_scaled = AFQT.3_1981 / 1000)

summary(final_data2$AFQT_scaled)

nrow(final_data2)
```

```{r}

model1 <- glm(PST0009_XRND ~ PRE0012_XRND, 
              data = final_data2, 
              family = gaussian())
summary(model1)


```

```{r}
model2 <-  glm(PST0009_XRND ~ PRE0012_XRND + CSEX_XRND + CRACE_XRND + 
               PST0002_XRND + PRE0010_XRND + 
              AFQT_scaled+ maternal_age, 
              data = final_data2, 
              family = gaussian())
summary(model2)



```

```{r}
model3 <- feols(PST0009_XRND ~ PRE0012_XRND + CSEX_XRND + CYRB_XRND | MPUBID_XRND,
```

```{r}

table_data <- final_data2 %>%
  mutate(
   
    Smoking = factor(PRE0012_XRND, 
                     levels = c(0, 1), 
                     labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    
   
    Child_Sex = factor(CSEX_XRND, 
                       levels = c(1, 2), 
                       labels = c("Male", "Female")),
    
    Child_Race = factor(CRACE_XRND, 
                        levels = c(1, 2, 3), 
                        labels = c("Hispanic", "Black", "Non-Black, Non-Hispanic")),
    
    Alcohol_Use = factor(PRE0010_XRND, 
                         levels = c(0, 1), 
                         labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    
    
    Birth_Year = CYRB_XRND,
    Gestational_Weeks = PST0002_XRND,
    Birth_Weight_oz = PST0009_XRND,
    AFQT_Score = `AFQT.3_1981`,
    maternal_age = maternal_age
  )


vars <- c("Child_Sex", "Child_Race", "Birth_Year", 
          "Alcohol_Use", "Gestational_Weeks", "Birth_Weight_oz", 
          "AFQT_Score","maternal_age")

factorVars <- c("Child_Sex", "Child_Race", "Alcohol_Use")

table1 <- CreateTableOne(vars = vars, 
                         strata = "Smoking",
                         factorVars = factorVars,
                         data = table_data)

print(table1, smd = TRUE, showAllLevels = TRUE)



```


```{r}
# Model 3 结果
effect <- 2.965  # 效应绝对值 (oz)
se_effect <- 0.995  # 标准误
sd_outcome <- 13.1  # RMSE 作为 outcome SD 

# 计算 E-value (需要提供 sd 参数)
evalues.OLS(est = effect, se = se_effect, sd = sd_outcome)
```

```{r}


table1_data <- final_data2 %>%
  mutate(
    Prenatal_Smoking = factor(PRE0012_XRND, 
                               levels = c(0, 1), 
                               labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    Child_Sex = factor(CSEX_XRND, 
                       levels = c(1, 2), 
                       labels = c("Male", "Female")),
    Child_Race = factor(CRACE_XRND, 
                        levels = c(1, 2, 3), 
                        labels = c("Hispanic", "Black", "Non-Black Non-Hispanic")),
    Prenatal_Alcohol = factor(PRE0010_XRND, 
                               levels = c(0, 1), 
                               labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    Birth_Weight_oz  = PST0009_XRND,
    Gestational_Weeks = PST0002_XRND,
    Birth_Year       = CYRB_XRND,
    AFQT_Score       = AFQT.3_1981,
    Maternal_Age     = maternal_age
  )

vars <- c("Child_Sex", "Child_Race", "Prenatal_Alcohol",
          "Gestational_Weeks", "Birth_Weight_oz",
          "Birth_Year", "AFQT_Score", "Maternal_Age")

factorVars <- c("Child_Sex", "Child_Race", "Prenatal_Alcohol")

table1 <- CreateTableOne(
  vars       = vars,
  strata     = "Prenatal_Smoking",
  factorVars = factorVars,
  data       = table1_data,
  addOverall = TRUE
)

print(table1, 
      smd          = TRUE, 
      showAllLevels = TRUE,
      formatOptions = list(big.mark = ","))




```

```{r}
m1_row <- tidy(model1, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term == "PRE0012_XRND") %>%
  mutate(Model = "Model 1: Unadjusted",
         Covariates = "None",
         `Sample Size` = 8744)

m2_row <- tidy(model2, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term == "PRE0012_XRND") %>%
  mutate(Model = "Model 2: Multivariable Adjusted",
         Covariates = "Child sex, race, gestational age, alcohol use, AFQT score, maternal age",
         `Sample Size` = 8744)

m3_row <- tidy(model3, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term == "PRE0012_XRND") %>%
  mutate(Model = "Model 3: Sibling Fixed-Effects",
         Covariates = "Child sex, birth year + mother fixed effects",
         `Sample Size` = 7093)

table2 <- bind_rows(m1_row, m2_row, m3_row) %>%
  mutate(
    Estimate = round(estimate, 3),
    `95% CI` = paste0("(", round(conf.low, 3), ", ", round(conf.high, 3), ")"),
    `p-value` = ifelse(p.value < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p.value, 3))
  ) %>%
  select(Model, Covariates, `Sample Size`, Estimate, `95% CI`, `p-value`)

print(table2)
```

```{r}
family_summary <- final_data2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(PST0009_XRND) & !is.na(PRE0012_XRND)) %>%
  group_by(MPUBID_XRND) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>%
  summarise(
    n_children = n(),
    discordant = n_distinct(PRE0012_XRND) > 1
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 家庭规模分布
table(family_summary$n_children)

# discordant情况
cat("Discordant families:", sum(family_summary$discordant), "\n")
cat("Concordant families:", sum(!family_summary$discordant), "\n")
cat("Total families:", nrow(family_summary), "\n")
cat("Discordant %:", round(mean(family_summary$discordant)*100, 1), "%\n")

```

```{r}
family_table <- family_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Family_Size = case_when(
      n_children == 2 ~ "2 children",
      n_children == 3 ~ "3 children",
      n_children == 4 ~ "4 children",
      n_children >= 5 ~ "5+ children"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Family_Size) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Families = n(),
    N_Discordant = sum(discordant),
    Pct_Discordant = round(mean(discordant) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Pct_Families = round(N_Families / sum(N_Families) * 100, 1)) %>%
  select(Family_Size, N_Families, Pct_Families, N_Discordant, Pct_Discordant)

# 加Total行
total_row <- data.frame(
  Family_Size = "Total",
  N_Families = nrow(family_summary),
  Pct_Families = 100.0,
  N_Discordant = sum(family_summary$discordant),
  Pct_Discordant = round(mean(family_summary$discordant) * 100, 1)
)

table4 <- bind_rows(family_table, total_row)
print(table4)
```

```{r}


# Step 1: Propensity Score Matching
psm_match <- matchit(
  PRE0012_XRND ~ CSEX_XRND + CRACE_XRND + PST0002_XRND + 
                 PRE0010_XRND + AFQT_scaled + maternal_age,
  data = final_data2,
  method = "nearest",
  distance = "logit",
  ratio = 1,
  replace = FALSE
)

# Step 2: 查看matching质量
summary(psm_match)

# Step 3: 提取matched数据
matched_data <- match.data(psm_match)

# Step 4: 检查匹配后SMD
library(tableone)
vars <- c("CSEX_XRND", "CRACE_XRND", "PST0002_XRND", 
          "PRE0010_XRND", "AFQT_scaled", "maternal_age")

table_before <- CreateTableOne(vars = vars, 
                                strata = "PRE0012_XRND", 
                                data = final_data2)

table_after <- CreateTableOne(vars = vars, 
                               strata = "PRE0012_XRND", 
                               data = matched_data)

print(table_before, smd = TRUE)
print(table_after, smd = TRUE)

# Step 5: 在matched sample上跑回归
model_psm <- lm(PST0009_XRND ~ PRE0012_XRND + CSEX_XRND + CRACE_XRND + 
                PST0002_XRND + PRE0010_XRND + AFQT_scaled + maternal_age,
                data = matched_data,
                weights = matched_data$weights)

summary(model_psm)

# Step 6: 对比三个estimate
cat("\n=== Sensitivity Analysis Summary ===\n")
cat("Model 2 (Multivariable):  ", round(coef(model2)["PRE0012_XRND"], 3), "\n")
cat("PSM (Matched sample):     ", round(coef(model_psm)["PRE0012_XRND"], 3), "\n")

```
